first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that reducing onboarding and signup friction improved completion, time-to-value, and early activation. This more directly addresses current funnel deterioration than pricing, whose prior retention harm conflicts with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective. Verification should confirm durability and downstream customer quality before commitment.

final.rationale: Run a targeted simplification experiment for SMB accounts with simple workspaces, where prior evidence shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, improved activation, and qualified-revenue lift. Explicitly exclude complex-workspace accounts and preserve their setup steps because shortening their flow increased 60-day churn. Evaluate activation alongside 30- and 60-day retention and qualified revenue; do not infer applicability beyond SMB or simple workspaces.
